company_name: FEI Co (a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific)
semiconductor_relevance: High — FEI Co, as part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, provides advanced equipment and solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing and research.
summary: FEI Co specializes in high-performance electron microscopy and imaging solutions that are essential for semiconductor research and development. Their technologies support critical processes in semiconductor fabrication, including inspection and measurement of materials at the nanoscale.
capabilities: Scanning Electron Microscopes (SEM) for semiconductor inspection
Focused Ion Beam (FIB) systems for sample preparation

regional_presence.China: Thermo Fisher Scientific has a significant presence in China with multiple manufacturing sites and application centers to support local semiconductor needs.
